Name: BUDDY_STONE_PARAM_ST
Description: Spirit summoning areas: each row is one Rebirth Monument stone (summoning pillar). The row is found by Stone Entity ID. Spirit ashes can be used while the player is in the stone's area (within Activation Distance of the stone, or inside the override region); spirits summoned there get the stone's SpEffect and set its flag.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game. Retail sets it on 287 of 304 rows.

Fields.Name: Stone Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of the stone in the map. The game finds this row by this value (not by the row ID), and Activation Distance is measured from this entity. Retail rows use the same value as the row ID.

Fields.Name: Defeat Target List Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity or group ID of the enemies the spirits are summoned against; the game checks whether any of them is alive within Activation Distance of the stone, and passes the ID to the summoned spirits. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Summoned Event Flag ID
Fields.Description: Event flag turned on when spirits are summoned at this stone. Also readable by the stone's talk script. 0 or -1: none.

Fields.Name: Is Special Monument
Fields.Description: Only returned to talk scripts; no other reader. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Buddy ID
Fields.Description: BuddyParam ID returned to talk scripts; no other reader. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Applied SpEffect ID
Fields.Description: SpEffect applied to every spirit summoned at this stone (re-applied when a spirit is moved back beside the player). -1: none. Retail 298000 on many rows.

Fields.Name: Activation Distance
Fields.Description: Summon area radius (m, straight-line from the stone): the player can summon while within this distance (replaced by the region when Overwrite Activation Region Entity ID is set). Beyond it, up to this distance + 15 m is the warning zone. Also the spirits' active range given to their AI, unless Overwrite Return Range is set. Retail 999 on most rows.

Fields.Name: Overwrite Return Range
Fields.Description: Active range (m) given to the spirits' AI in place of Activation Distance. -1: use Activation Distance.

Fields.Name: Overwrite Activation Region Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of a map region used as the summon area instead of Activation Distance: the player can summon while inside it. 0 or -1: use Activation Distance.

Fields.Name: Warn Region Entity ID
Fields.Description: Entity ID of a map region used as the warning zone (outside the summon area, about to leave it) when the summon area is a region. 0 or -1: the warning zone is within 15 m of the summon region.
